selection.selection_data: Validation only; dedicated unlabeled timing inputs; no new test outcomes accessed
selection.criterion: Minimize sum of independently measured branch mean latency subject to AP50 and AP50:95 in EACH branch >= retention*same-branch 640 FP32 validation metric. This retention ratio is an engineering constraint, not a safety guarantee. Joint timing is checked separately.
